title: Requests and company
summary: Tell and politely ask people to do things (*Gel!*, *Oturyň!*) or not to (*Gelme!*, *Gelmäň!*), say who you are with and who something is for with *bilen* and *üçin* (*ejäm bilen*, *seniň üçin*), and join ideas with *we, ýöne, emma, ýa-da* and *şonuň üçin*. And order a meal in a café.
canDo: Invite someone in, offer them a seat and something to eat or drink
Ask people politely to do or not to do something
Say who you go somewhere with and how you travel
Order in a café and ask for the bill
vocabThemes: at table and in a café
